dockerfile.description: No Dockerfile here is shipped: sonic-buildimage builds the REST API container from its own. Dockerfile.build and Dockerfile.test are CI images whose base follows the sonic-slave container's distribution, and the others are unused

packageRules.description: Renovate merges the updates the preset labels automerge: security updates below a major version, except patched modules. It merges on a later run, once every check on the head commit has passed, not only the required ones, and the renovate-approve app has approved the pull request. Reviewers are still assigned, so one that fails reaches them.
